# Acme GmbH — monthly financial report, October 2025

Reporting entity: Acme GmbH.
Reporting period: October 2025.

Total revenue for the period: EUR 1,240,000.

Revenue was driven by recurring service contracts and one-off project work. Operating costs were in line with the budget for the period.

# Beta Ltd — monthly financial report, October 2025

Reporting entity: Beta Ltd.
Reporting period: October 2025.

Total revenue for the period: GBP 860,000.

Revenue was driven by recurring service contracts and one-off project work. Operating costs were in line with the budget for the period.

Quarterly Note
Revenue rose 12 percent in Q3.
